subject: Plan anchors: resource prioritization, targets & contingency tiers
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Plan anchors: resource prioritization, targets & contingency tiers

Team —

This is the kickoff for FY28 annual planning and QBR-ready OKR alignment. High level asks for this thread:

- Agree on 3 topline target buckets (Base, Upside, Stress) we can commit to for planning decks.
- Surface material resource constraints (GPU, infra spend, headcount) by team.
- Define two contingency tiers and the triggers (latency, ARR churn, budget delta).

I attached a draft workbook (FY28-plan-anchors-v1.xlsx) and a short guidelines doc. Please do two things this week:

1) By EOD Wed: each of you add concise resource notes for teams you lead (1–3 bullets per team).
2) By EOD Fri: fill the topline target rows (Base/Upside/Stress) with assumptions and a short rationale.

I'll compile for a leadership readout next Monday. We'll use this to shape the QBR slides and any pre-read for board touches. If you think the scope needs a separate working group (finance, CS, infra), call it out in your reply.

Thanks — short and tactical here.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer 
VP, Product & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: FY28-plan-anchors-v1.xlsx (workbook, 120KB)
Attachment: scenario-guidelines-v2.pdf (doc, 85KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Plan anchors: resource prioritization, targets & contingency tiers

Thanks — added initial notes to the workbook (sheet: Product & Infra). Quick highlights:

- GPU capacity: current steady-state supports 50% more baseline traffic; Upside needs a 2x burst plan for 3 months (spot + reserved mix).
- Infra spend: we can reallocate up to 8% from non-customer facing tools without impacting SLAs; bigger shifts require exec sign-off.
- Hiring: PM and SWE hiring velocity likely limited by Q3; recommend a temporary contracting buffer for model onboarding.

I also captured two triggers for the contingency tiers: sustained 20% higher token volume for 10 consecutive days, and a 15% QoQ ARR shortfall in bundled offerings.

Question: do we want Finance on the base target sign-off or only for Upside/Stress scenarios where we might pull forward spend? I can loop Nina from Extern to run quick sanity checks on scenario assumptions (they did our FY26 stress modeling).

Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Appending two quick items from the leadership side:

- Sales bookings cadence: I'll add a conservative cadence for Base and a set of conversion levers for Upside (enterprise pilots + Marketplace pushes).
- SLAs & security: for Upside, we will need to confirm extra Dedicated capacity lead time (60–90 days). Monica — please flag any implications for customer commitments.

I'll add notes into the workbook and call out dependencies. Agree we should include Finance on Upside/Stress validation.

Laura

Redwood Inference

Nice thread — short operational asks from me:

- I'll schedule a 60-minute leadership sync next Tue (calendar invite to follow). Agenda: 1) review compiled Base/Upside/Stress numbers, 2) confirm contingency triggers and owners, 3) agree on QBR pre-read timeline.
- Monica/Laura: please send any hot-ticket dependencies (procurement lead time, MSA changes, marketplace certs) in a shared doc by Thu COB so I can surface them to Finance.
- Karthik: do you want a consolidated SLT pre-read or the raw workbook? My recommendation: consolidated 1-pager + workbook in appendix.

I'll loop Nina from Extern for a short sanity check meeting on Thursday afternoon if that's useful — she confirmed availability.

Aditya
